* The method results in images that are darker than ground-truth because distant contributions are ignored [S1].

The claim states that the method results in darker images than ground-truth because distant contributions are ignored. The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly states: 'We can choose to stop traversal when a node ... subtends a certain solid angle.
